messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary cohort eu-west-1 — 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Error rate 3.8% (baseline 0.1%). Rolling deploy id: rollout-2026-03-17-ff2. <https://deploys.redwood/rollout-ff2|rollout-ff2>

maria: seeing tail latency increase + KV evictions. Canaries only but they're at 20% traffic for eu-west. Reproducible on a few requests.

john-oncall: paging oncall — can we pause/kill the rollout? If canary is causing 5xx we should stop traffic and consider kill-switch.

deploy-bot: Rollout rollout-2026-03-17-ff2 started by @cs-releases at 17:02 UTC. Commit: a1b2c3d. Canary policy: 20% eu-west -> 100% over 15m.

sam: I think the new routing plugin that shards KV across nodes is causing evictions. Seeing repeated OOM evict logs and upstream timeouts.

maria: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T17:04:12Z] kvcache: evict key shard-3 size=128MB reason=oom
[2026-03-17T17:04:15Z] inference: 502 upstream read timeout id=xyz-123
[2026-03-17T17:04:18Z] router: stream reset from shard-3
```

anna: recommending feature-flag `routing-new-shard` -> OFF immediately. @sam @john-oncall can someone flip it?

sam: flipping now. command: `curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/api/flags/routing-new-shard/disable -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_KEY'` 

deploy-bot: feature flag `routing-new-shard` disabled by sam at 17:06 UTC.

incident-bot: Observing error rate drop to 0.4% over last 2m after flag disable. Continuing to monitor for stabilization.

customer-success: CS notes: 12 customers reported degraded responses; 2 customers reported payment retries failing during the window. Escalated to billing ops.

john-oncall: pausing rollout and queuing rollback to previous stable. @cs-ux please notify impacted customers (template: short outage + workaround). Incident created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0317-01

deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Rollback queued -> rollback-2026-03-17-ff2 -> target commit a1b2b3c. ETA ~8m.

alex: I start oncall in 30m; taking handoff if this stays open. @sam ensure traces + kvstats are preserved for postmortem.

sam: ack — collecting kvstats, perf traces, and will produce timeline. Will also snapshot node heap stats.

john-oncall: postmortem owner: sam. Severity: Sev2. Handoff notes: mitigation actions performed (flag disable + pause). Monitor for 30m; if error rate <0.5% and no regressions, we can demobilize.

alex: ack, monitoring. Ping me if we see any regression or increase. :thumbsup:
